feature: Owner search by exact last name
requirements:
REQ-OWNER-SEARCH-01: Search requires a non-empty last name.
REQ-OWNER-SEARCH-02: An exact match displays identifier, full name, address, city and telephone number.
expected_behavior: Produces a grounded normal test for an exact last-name match.

feature: Owner search with one-character last name
requirements:
REQ-OWNER-SEARCH-01: Search accepts a non-empty last name.
REQ-OWNER-SEARCH-03: A partial value with several matches displays a selectable owner list.
expected_behavior: Recognises one character as the smallest non-empty input and tests multiple matches.

requirements: REQ-OWNER-SEARCH-05: A blank search value is rejected with a validation message.
expected_behavior: Proposes a blank-input validation test without inventing message wording.

requirements: REQ-OWNER-SEARCH-04: No match displays a clear no-results message and does not open an unrelated owner record.
expected_behavior: Checks both the message and the absence of unrelated navigation.

requirements:
REQ-OWNER-ADD-01: First name, last name, address, city and telephone are required.
REQ-OWNER-ADD-03: A valid submission creates one owner and displays its details.
expected_behavior: Produces a valid-creation scenario with the required fields.

requirements:
REQ-OWNER-ADD-02: Telephone contains between 1 and 10 numeric digits.
REQ-OWNER-ADD-04: Invalid input preserves entered non-sensitive values and displays field-level validation.
expected_behavior: Tests accepted lengths 1 and 10 and at least one rejected value outside the range.

feature: Create owner with a missing required field
requirements:
REQ-OWNER-ADD-01: First name, last name, address, city and telephone are required.
REQ-OWNER-ADD-04: Invalid submission preserves entered non-sensitive values and shows field-level validation.
expected_behavior: Checks field-level validation and preservation without claiming a record was created.

requirements:
REQ-OWNER-UPDATE-01: Address, city and telephone may be updated.
REQ-OWNER-UPDATE-02: Updating does not change the owner identifier.
expected_behavior: Checks editable fields and identifier stability.
